improvement_recommendations.main_focus: Reduce token usage and optimize model pricing while maintaining answer quality

recommendations.title: Reduce input tokens
recommendations.description: Reduce unnecessary prompt instructions, duplicate context, and irrelevant retrieved chunks.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Lower input token cost per query

recommendations.title: Reduce output tokens
recommendations.description: Use concise answer instructions and limit maximum output tokens when detailed answers are not required.

recommendations.title: Optimize retrieved context
recommendations.description: Reduce unnecessary top_k and chunk overlap while maintaining retrieval quality.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Smaller prompts and lower input cost

recommendations.title: Use prompt caching
recommendations.description: Take advantage of provider prompt caching for repeated system prompt prefixes when supported.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Lower cost for cached input tokens

recommendations.title: Use a cheaper model when suitable
recommendations.description: Test a lower-cost model for simple questions while preserving quality for complex questions.

recommendations.title: Cache repeated work
recommendations.description: Cache repeated questions, embeddings, and retrieval results where appropriate.
recommendations.expected_benefit: Lower repeated computation and API cost

recommendations.title: Monitor production token usage
recommendations.description: Track input, output, and cached tokens in production to compare actual billing with offline estimates.

recommended_order: Use a cheaper model when suitable
